name: linkedin-ai-reply-assistant
description: Chrome extension that provides AI-generated reply suggestions for LinkedIn posts and comments

scripts.build: npm run type-check && vite build && vite build --mode content && npm run verify && npm run smoke && npm run test:prompt
scripts.build:prod: npm run clean && npm run type-check && vite build --mode production && vite build --mode content && npm run verify && npm run smoke && npm run test:prompt
